# Lenis 1.3.27

Official browser distribution, downloaded from the npm registry on 20 October 2026.

- Source and documentation: https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis
- License: MIT; retained in `LICENSE`.
- Package tarball integrity was checked against npm's SHA-512 value before writing files.
- `package-source.json` records the exact version, origin, integrity and asset SHA-256 hashes.

These assets are loaded by the current website. Lenis uses the shared GSAP ticker; touch scrolling stays native. The device reduced-motion setting or the site’s Motion control disables smoothing. There is no build step or runtime CDN dependency.

Integration plan: [Website motion plan](../../../V6/docs/WEBSITE_MOTION_PLAN_2026-10-20.md).
